content.text:
* Continuous-time SKY130 LDO, nominal output 1.2 V from a 0.6 V reference.
* MOS W and L are in micrometres under the pinned PDK scale.
.subckt DUT VIN VOUT VSS VREF
* Resistor-fed bias and a 3:1 NMOS tail-current mirror.
RBIAS VIN BIAS 150k
XNBIAS BIAS BIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XNTAIL TAIL BIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=30 l=1 nf=1 m=1
* NMOS differential input stage with PMOS mirror load.
XNFB N1 FB TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XNREF GATE REF TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XP1 N1 N1 VIN VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=40 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XP2 GATE N1 VIN VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=40 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
* Three parallel pass devices provide low-supply headroom at 2 mA.
XPPASS VOUT GATE VIN VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.15 nf=1 m=3
* Matched supply terms place both inputs near 0.84--0.96 V.
* The small divider offset centers the finite-gain DC error across corners.
RREF1 VIN REF 1.4meg
RREF2 REF VREF 600k
RFB1 VOUT FB 149k
RFB2 FB VSS 151.013513513514k
RFB3 VIN FB 175k
* Fast output feedback, series-RC compensation, and reference bypass.
CFF VOUT FB 1p
RCOMP VOUT CM 50k
CCOMP CM GATE 0.3p
CREF REF VREF 5p
* Match the supply response of the input-divider paths.
RREFAC VIN RAC 40k
CREFAC RAC REF 2.2p
.ends DUT
